Subject: Redwood DPA redlines + incident notification proposal

Hi all — attaching our redline set (Redwood_DPA_Redlines_20271101.pdf). Summary of the material points from Legal: 

1) Incident notification windows: proposed compromise below to address your 48-hour requirement while protecting the integrity of investigations:
   - Initial notification: Redwood will provide an initial electronic notice within 48 hours of reasonably confirming that a qualifying incident occurred. That notice will include a summary of the scope, impacted data classes, and immediate containment steps.
   - Follow-up report: Redwood will provide a more detailed follow-up report within 72 hours of the initial notice where feasible; if forensic timelines require more time, we'll notify you of the expected delivery date and interim findings.

2) Subprocessor visibility: we will provide an up-to-date subprocessor registry as a separate CSV and commit to 30 days' notice for any new subprocessors that process customer data. For emergency engagements (e.g., urgent infra for incident response), we will notify customers ASAP and include a justification.

3) Audit artifacts/log retention: Redwood retains request logs and trace-level telemetry for 13 months by default and can provide exportable logs on a one-time request within 14 days for compliance reviews; for longer-term retention, we can add a support add-on.

4) DocuSign execution: Legal requests that the customer sign the current redline PDF via DocuSign and add a designated counter-signature block for Redwood's authorized signer (VP Legal). We will generate the envelope and share a secure link; please confirm the PROCUREMENT signer's name and email.

Next steps: Evelyn/Marissa — please confirm procurement signers and target sign-off date. Olivia — if FinBank is comfortable with the 48h initial / 72h follow-up compromise we proposed, we'll prepare the envelope by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com

- Subprocessor evidence: procurement needs the current subprocessor CSV and a statement on whether any subprocessors are located outside the EU/UK (we have cross-border review requirements).

If Redwood can produce the DocuSign envelope with the redlines accepted and subprocessor CSV attached, Samir will sign within 48 hours. Thanks — we'll aim to close by 2027-11-05.
